<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 183.0451 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The observed M+1 intensity (~10 %) is consistent with a molecule containing about 8–9 carbon atoms. A formula that matches the exact mass within a few mDa and the isotopic pattern is C₈H₈NO₄. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C8H8NO4.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8NO4</final_answer>
